onboardingEvidence.provenanceEvidence: The official careers page links eight specific vacancies under jobs.ashbyhq.com/axelera, including 07605701-fef5-47d3-aef3-2897e59fee20 and 76a02d45-2560-4d08-8289-02c8f7efb24e. The unfiltered hosted board also includes UKESF.
onboardingEvidence.countEvidence: The hosted board's window.__appData.jobBoard.jobPostings contains nine published postings, with the same nine identities as the posting API. No separate scalar total was exposed; this is the complete published array count, not a count inferred from source.company.
onboardingEvidence.pagination: GET with Accept: application/json; top-level keys jobs and apiVersion. The public posting endpoint returns the full board in one response, with all nine isListed values true. Descriptions are inline in descriptionPlain/descriptionHtml.
onboardingEvidence.identityEvidence: Director - Silicon Logical Design: Hybrid/Remote - Europe (incl. UK). Director - Silicon Product & Test Engineering: Bristol (on-site). Finance Manager: Eindhoven (hybrid). Their IDs match the employer's own careers links.
onboardingEvidence.countryEvidence: The official careers page explicitly identifies headquarters at High Tech Campus, Eindhoven, and gives the Netherlands address.
onboardingEvidence.robotsEvidence: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt returns 200 and disallows /meeting/, /b/ and /api/. https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt returns 401 Unauthorized, while the public posting API returns 200. Override remains enabled.
